attributes.name: coatingThickness
attributes.description: Vector storing information about coating thickness in each segment. It is assumed that the linear unit of coating thickness is 1000 times smaller than the unit of radius (e.g., if the simulation basic unit is meter, then coating thickness is provided in milimeters). It is one-dimensional, hence for easier intepretation can be reshaped based on the information about thetaResolution and phiResolution.
